reason: This PR is plausibly centered on planner/executor behavior, not just bindinfo internals: it directly changes `pkg/planner/core/planbuilder.go`, `pkg/planner/optimize.go`, and `pkg/executor/bind.go`, and also updates planner integration testdata (`rule_join_reorder`).
